scientific_question: Does either preregistered causal Hurst representation add stable outer-development value over the identical no-Hurst executable-direction model after secondary calibration label-interval purge?
search_space_policy: Exactly 3 arms x 4 horizons; fixed Logistic Regression estimator; calibration and margin are inner selection alternatives only.
multiplicity_policy: Holm correction across the four preregistered horizons within each contrast family; the robust family remains secondary.
secondary_calibration_purge: Retain only calibration events with executable_label_end_index < evaluation_start_row_id.
audit_prohibition: No historical_audit_previously_revealed file or metric may be loaded during v3 development selection.
stop_rule: Run exactly the 12 registered arm-horizon trials once; do not expand v3.
